js: (async()=>{const A=__CITY_APP,s=A.scene;const sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const meas=async()=>{await sleep(1200);let n=0;const t=performance.now();await new Promise(res=>{(function f(){n++;if(performance.now()-t<2500)requestAnimationFrame(f);else res()})()});return ((performance.now()-t)/n).toFixed(1)};const out=[];out.push('base '+await meas());const G=s.getObjectByName('CityGround');const by=new Map();G.traverse(o=>{if(o.isMesh){const k=o.name||o.material.name||'?';if(!by.has(k))by.set(k,[]);by.get(k).push(o)}});for(const [k,list] of by){const vis=list.filter(o=>o.visible);if(!vis.length)continue;vis.forEach(o=>o.visible=false);out.push(k+'('+list.length+','+(list[0].material.type)+') '+await meas());vis.forEach(o=>o.visible=true)}const B=s.getObjectByName('CityBuildings');B.children.forEach(c=>console.log('[bchild] '+c.name+' '+c.type+' '+(c.material&&c.material.type)));console.log('[ablate3] '+out.join(' | '))})()
